experiments.title: Duplicate idempotency requests (sequential)
experiments.description: Each key is sent several times with the same payload (successful and rolled-back originals), then once with a different payload.

criteria.description: Exactly one transaction per key (success and rollback originals)
Replayed responses identical to the original
Reused key with a different payload rejected (422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED)
Every transaction reached a terminal state
No ACTIVE (provisional) lock outlives its transaction
ROLLED_BACK/FAILED transactions hold no CONFIRMED locks

findings: 30 of 30 replayed responses were byte-identical to the original response.
